svg.title: 并行执行：逐个准备、保存任务、并发执行，完成事件及时发送，结果消息按原顺序投递。

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
按原调用顺序发送 start
逐个 await prepare

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
发送该调用的 end
保存现成的结果对象

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
保存 async 函数
此时不执行函数体

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: map 遍历已收集的 entry

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
entry() 启动任务
不等待前一任务完成再启动下一个

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
各任务内部依次执行
execute → finalize → end → 返回结果

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Promise.all 等待所有任务
成功时按输入位置组织结果

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
按原调用顺序构造结果消息
逐个 await message_start、message_end

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
收集 messages，汇总 terminate
返回批次结果给 runLoop
